<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\NotificationInboxRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageOperationException;

final class NotificationInbox
{
    private NotificationInboxRepository $repository;
    public function __construct(NotificationInboxRepository $repository) { $this->repository = $repository; }
    public function summary(array $actor): array { return $this->repository->summary($actor); }
    public function list(array $actor, int $page, string $throughId = ''): array
    {
        if(strlen($throughId)>80)throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围无效','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID');
        return $this->repository->list($actor,max(1,min(10000,$page)),trim($throughId));
    }
    private function threadRepository(string $cursor): \WorkerAdmin\Contracts\NotificationThreadRepository
    {
        if(strlen($cursor)>2048)throw new MessageOperationException('通知浏览范围无效','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        if(!$this->repository instanceof \WorkerAdmin\Contracts\NotificationThreadRepository)throw new MessageOperationException('通知分页暂不可用','NOTIFICATION_CURSOR_UNAVAILABLE',503);
        return $this->repository;
    }
    public function threads(array $actor,string $cursor=''): array
    {return $this->threadRepository($cursor)->threads($actor,$cursor);}
    public function threadMessages(array $actor,string $cursor): array
    {
        if($cursor==='')throw new MessageOperationException('请刷新通知列表','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        return $this->threadRepository($cursor)->threadMessages($actor,$cursor);
    }
    public function readRange(array $actor,string $cursor): void
    {
        if($cursor==='')throw new MessageOperationException('请刷新通知列表','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        $this->threadRepository($cursor)->readRange($actor,$cursor);
    }
    public function read(array $actor, string $id): void
    {
        $id = trim($id);
        if ($id === '') throw new MessageOperationException('请选择要查看的消息', 'NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED');
        $this->repository->read($actor, $id);
    }
    public function readBatch(array $actor, array $rawIds): array
    {
        if (count($rawIds) > 50) throw new MessageOperationException('单次最多标记 50 条消息', 'NOTIFICATION_BATCH_LIMIT');
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($rawIds as $value) {
            if (!is_scalar($value)) continue;
            $value = trim((string)$value);
            if ($value !== '' && !in_array($value, $ids, true)) $ids[] = $value;
        }
        if (!$ids) throw new MessageOperationException('请选择要查看的消息', 'NOTIFICATION_REQUIRED');
        return ['updated_count' => $this->repository->readBatch($actor, $ids)];
    }
    public function readAll(array $actor, string $throughId = ''): void
    {
        if (strlen($throughId)>80) throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围无效','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID');
        $this->repository->readAll($actor,trim($throughId));
    }
}

    private function attention(array $actor): array
    {
        [$userTodo,$userParams] = DatabaseOrderCenterRepository::scope($actor,'mine','todo');
        [$workerTodo,$workerParams] = DatabaseOrderCenterRepository::scope($actor,'worker','todo');
        [$userRead,$userReadParams] = DatabaseOrderCenterRepository::scope($actor,'mine','all');
        [$workerRead,$workerReadParams] = DatabaseOrderCenterRepository::scope($actor,'worker','all');
        $workerId=(int)($actor['worker_id']??0);
        // Only a canonical internal order ID and the current receiver's order
        // scope can merge a notice into B. Invalid/missing/unowned links stay S.
        $orderId="JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(IF(JSON_VALID(n.data_json),n.data_json,'{}'),'$.order_id'))";
        $orderType="JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(IF(JSON_VALID(n.data_json),n.data_json,'{}'),'$.order_id'))";
        $match="{$orderType} IN ('INTEGER','STRING') AND {$orderId} REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$' AND o.id=CAST({$orderId} AS UNSIGNED) AND BINARY CAST(o.id AS CHAR)=BINARY {$orderId}
            AND ((n.recipient_type='user' AND ({$userRead})) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND ({$workerRead})))";
        $owned="n.channel='in_app' AND n.read_at IS NULL AND ((n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:attention_user) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :attention_worker_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:attention_worker))";
        // UNION deduplicates identity+order across todos and any number of
        // order notices. Kind separates unrelated notification IDs from orders.
        $sql="SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kind='order'),0) order_attention_count,COALESCE(SUM(kind='standalone'),0) standalone_unread_count FROM (
            SELECT 'order' kind,'user' identity_kind,o.id item_id FROM orders o WHERE {$userTodo}
            UNION SELECT 'order','worker',o.id FROM orders o WHERE {$workerTodo}
            UNION SELECT IF(o.id IS NULL,'standalone','order'),n.recipient_type,IF(o.id IS NULL,n.id,o.id)
                FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN orders o ON {$match} WHERE {$owned}
        ) attention_items";
        $params=$userParams+$workerParams+$userReadParams+$workerReadParams+['attention_user'=>(int)$actor['user_id'],'attention_worker_enabled'=>$workerId,'attention_worker'=>$workerId];
        $row=$this->db->fetch($sql,$params);
        return ['order_attention_count'=>(int)$row['order_attention_count'],'standalone_unread_count'=>(int)$row['standalone_unread_count']];
    }

    public function list(array $actor, int $page, string $throughId = ''): array
    {
        $limit = 20;
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $limit;
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $where = "n.channel='in_app' AND ( (n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:user_id) OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:worker_id) )";
        $params = ['user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        // Capture the range before loading the list, not after it. Later pages
        // retain the same owned public ID so arrivals cannot shift offsets.
        $boundary=$this->db->fetch('SELECT n.id,n.public_id FROM notifications n WHERE '.$where.($throughId!==''?' AND n.public_id=:through_id':'').' ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1',$throughId!==''?$params+['through_id'=>$throughId]:$params);
        if($throughId!==''&&!$boundary)throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围已失效，请刷新后重试','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID',404);
        $throughId=$boundary?(string)$boundary['public_id']:'';
        $unreadCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE ' . $where . ' AND n.read_at IS NULL', $params);
        $rows = $this->db->fetchAll('SELECT n.public_id,n.recipient_type,n.template_key,n.title,n.content,n.data_json,n.read_at,n.created_at FROM notifications n WHERE ' . $where . ' AND n.id<=:range_cutoff ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT ' . ($limit + 1) . ' OFFSET ' . $offset, $params+['range_cutoff'=>$boundary?(int)$boundary['id']:0]);
        $hasMore = count($rows) > $limit;

        // V2.2.3：先解析本页关联订单，再一次性批量取订单号，避免每条通知额外执行一次 SQL。
        $preparedRows = []; $orderIds = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $data = (json_decode((string)($row['data_json'] ?? ''), true) ?: []);
            $orderId = is_array($data) ? (int) ($data['order_id'] ?? 0) : 0;
            if ($orderId > 0) $orderIds[$orderId] = true;
            $preparedRows[] = ['row' => $row, 'order_id' => $orderId];
        }
        $orderNoById = [];
        if ($orderIds) {
            $safeIds = array_map('intval', array_keys($orderIds));
            foreach ($this->db->fetchAll('SELECT id,public_no FROM orders WHERE id IN (' . implode(',', $safeIds) . ')') as $orderRow) {
                $orderNoById[(int) $orderRow['id']] = (string) $orderRow['public_no'];
            }
        }
        $items = [];
        foreach ($preparedRows as $prepared) {
            $row = $prepared['row']; $orderId = (int) $prepared['order_id'];
            $items[] = [
                'id' => (string) $row['public_id'], 'recipient_type' => (string) $row['recipient_type'],
                'template_key' => (string) $row['template_key'], 'title' => (string) $row['title'],
                'content' => (string) $row['content'], 'read' => !empty($row['read_at']),
                'created_at' => $this->localTime($row['created_at']), 'order_id' => $orderId,
                'order_no' => $orderNoById[$orderId] ?? '', 'detail_page' => $row['recipient_type'] === 'worker' ? 'worker' : 'user',
            ];
        }
        return ['items' => $items, 'page' => $page, 'has_more' => $hasMore, 'unread_count' => $unreadCount, 'read_through_id'=>$throughId];

    }

    public function read(array $actor, string $publicId): void
    {
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $params = ['public_id' => $publicId, 'user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        $owned = $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE public_id=:public_id AND channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id)) LIMIT 1", $params);
        if (!$owned) throw new MessageOperationException('消息不存在或不属于当前账号', 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND', 404);
        $this->db->execute("UPDATE notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE id=:id", ['id' => (int) $owned]);

    }

    public function readBatch(array $actor, array $ids): int
    {
        $workerId = !empty($actor['worker_id']) ? (int) $actor['worker_id'] : 0;
        $marks = [];
        $params = ['user_id' => (int) $actor['user_id'], 'worker_enabled' => $workerId, 'worker_id' => $workerId];
        foreach ($ids as $index => $publicId) {
            $key = 'notification_' . $index;
            $marks[] = ':' . $key;
            $params[$key] = $publicId;
        }
        $changed = $this->db->execute("UPDATE notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE public_id IN (" . implode(',', $marks) . ") AND channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id))", $params);
        return $changed;

    }

    public function readAll(array $actor, string $throughId = ''): void
    {
        $workerId=!empty($actor['worker_id'])?(int)$actor['worker_id']:0;
        $params=['user_id'=>(int)$actor['user_id'],'worker_enabled'=>$workerId,'worker_id'=>$workerId];
        $where="channel='in_app' AND ((recipient_type='user' AND recipient_id=:user_id) OR (recipient_type='worker' AND :worker_enabled>0 AND recipient_id=:worker_id))";
        if($throughId!==''){
            $cutoff=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT id FROM notifications WHERE '.$where.' AND public_id=:through_id LIMIT 1',$params+['through_id'=>$throughId]);
            if(!$cutoff)throw new MessageOperationException('通知范围已失效，请刷新后重试','NOTIFICATION_RANGE_INVALID',404);
        }else{
            // Old clients also receive a server-side cutoff before the UPDATE.
            $cutoff=$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM notifications WHERE '.$where,$params);
        }
        $this->db->execute('UPDATE notifications SET read_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE '.$where.' AND read_at IS NULL AND id<=:cutoff',$params+['cutoff'=>(int)$cutoff]);
    }


    private function threadExpression(): string
    {
        $json="IF(JSON_VALID(n.data_json),n.data_json,'{}')";
        $id="JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT({$json},'$.order_id'))";
        $type="JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT({$json},'$.order_id'))";
        // Identity remains part of the key. An association is never an order access grant.
        return "CASE WHEN {$type} IN ('INTEGER','STRING') AND {$id} REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}($value): ?string
    {
        if (!$value) return null;
        try {
            return (new DateTimeImmutable((string) $value, new DateTimeZone('UTC')))->setTimezone(new DateTimeZone((string) \app_config('app.timezone', 'Asia/Shanghai')))->format('Y-m-d H:i');
        } catch (Throwable $exception) { return (string) $value; }
    }
}
            AND BINARY CAST(CAST({$id} AS UNSIGNED) AS CHAR)=BINARY {$id}
            THEN CONCAT(n.recipient_type,':',{$id}) ELSE CONCAT('single:',n.public_id) END";
    }
    private function notificationScope(array $actor): array
    {
        return ["n.channel='in_app' AND ((n.recipient_type='user' AND n.recipient_id=:thread_user)
            OR (n.recipient_type='worker' AND :thread_enabled>0 AND n.recipient_id=:thread_worker))",
            ['thread_user'=>(int)$actor['user_id'],'thread_enabled'=>(int)($actor['worker_id']??0),'thread_worker'=>(int)($actor['worker_id']??0)]];
    }
    private function threadRange(array $actor,string $cursor,string $kind): array
    {
        $signer=new \WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging\NotificationInboxCursor();
        [$where,$params]=$this->notificationScope($actor);
        if($cursor===''&&$kind!=='threads')throw new MessageOperationException('请刷新通知列表','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        if($cursor===''){
            $anchor=$this->db->fetch('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(n.id),0) max_id,COUNT(*) total FROM notifications n WHERE '.$where,$params);
            $state=$signer->begin($actor,(string)$anchor['max_id'],(string)$anchor['total']);
        }else $state=$signer->open($actor,$cursor,$kind);
        $params['thread_max']=$state['max'];$where.=' AND n.id<=:thread_max';
        $count=(string)$this->db->fetchValue('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE '.$where,$params);
        // Read flags may change without invalidation; deleted members require an explicit resync.
        if($count!==$state['count'])throw new MessageOperationException('通知浏览范围已变化，请下拉刷新','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        return [$signer,$state,$where,$params];
    }
    public function threads(array $actor,string $cursor=''): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function()use($actor,$cursor):array{
            [$signer,$state,$where,$params]=$this->threadRange($actor,$cursor,'threads');
            $expr=$this->threadExpression();
            $sort="CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),LPAD(CAST(n.id AS CHAR),20,'0'))";
            $after='';
            if($state['before']!==''){$after=' WHERE g.sort_key<:thread_before';$params['thread_before']=$state['before'];}
            $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT g.thread_key,g.thread_count,g.unread_count,g.sort_key,n.public_id,n.recipient_type,n.template_key,n.title,n.content,n.created_at,n.read_at
                FROM (SELECT {$expr} thread_key,COUNT(*) thread_count,SUM(n.read_at IS NULL) unread_count,MAX({$sort}) sort_key
                    FROM notifications n WHERE {$where} GROUP BY thread_key) g
                JOIN notifications n ON n.id=CAST(SUBSTRING(g.sort_key,20) AS UNSIGNED){$after} ORDER BY g.sort_key DESC LIMIT 21",$params);
            $more=count($rows)>20;$rows=array_slice($rows,0,20);$items=[];$orders=$this->threadOrders($actor,$rows);
            foreach($rows as $row){
                $item=$this->threadItem($row,$orders);
                $item['thread_cursor']=$signer->seal($state,'messages',(string)$row['thread_key']);
                $items[]=$item;
            }
            return ['schema'=>2,'items'=>$items,'has_more'=>$more,
                'next_cursor'=>$more?$signer->seal($state,'threads','',(string)end($rows)['sort_key']):'',
                'range_cursor'=>$signer->seal($state,'range'),'unread_count'=>$this->notificationUnread($actor)];
        });
    }
    public function threadMessages(array $actor,string $cursor): array
    {
        return $this->db->transaction(function()use($actor,$cursor):array{
            [$signer,$state,$where,$params]=$this->threadRange($actor,$cursor,'messages');
            $expr=$this->threadExpression();
            $sort="CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),LPAD(CAST(n.id AS CHAR),20,'0'))";
            $params['thread_key']=$state['thread'];$where.=" AND ({$expr})=:thread_key";
            if($state['before']!==''){$where.=" AND {$sort}<:thread_before";$params['thread_before']=$state['before'];}
            $rows=$this->db->fetchAll("SELECT n.public_id,n.recipient_type,n.template_key,n.title,n.content,n.read_at,n.created_at,{$sort} sort_key
                FROM notifications n WHERE {$where} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 21",$params);
            $more=count($rows)>20;$rows=array_slice($rows,0,20);
            $items=array_map(fn(array $row):array=>$this->notificationItem($row),$rows);
            return ['schema'=>2,'thread_key'=>$state['thread'],'items'=>$items,'has_more'=>$more,
                'next_cursor'=>$more?$signer->seal($state,'messages',$state['thread'],(string)end($rows)['sort_key']):''];
        });
    }
    public function readRange(array $actor,string $cursor): void
    {

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace WorkerAdmin\Http\Api\Modules;
use RuntimeException;

use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageOperationException;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Order\OrderOperationException;
/** Subscription settings and the signed-in actor's notification inbox. */
final class MessagingApiModule implements ApiModule
{
    private const ROUTES = [
        'announcement.current'=>'GET',
        'subscriptions.status'=>'GET', 'subscriptions.diagnose'=>'GET', 'subscriptions.preference'=>'POST',
        'notifications.threads'=>'GET','notifications.thread_messages'=>'GET','notifications.summary'=>'GET', 'notifications.list'=>'GET', 'notifications.read'=>'POST',
        'notifications.read_batch'=>'POST', 'notifications.read_all'=>'POST',
    ];
    private \WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging\AnnouncementQuery $announcement;
    private ApiActorResolver $actors;
    private NotificationInbox $inbox;
    private SubscriptionPreferences $subscriptions;
    public function __construct(Database $db, ?ApiActorResolver $actors=null, ?NotificationInbox $inbox=null, ?SubscriptionPreferences $subscriptions=null)
    {
        $container = new MessagingApplicationContainer($db);
        $this->announcement=new \WorkerAdmin\Application\Messaging\AnnouncementQuery((new ApplicationContainer($db))->settings());
        $this->actors = $actors ?: (new ApplicationContainer($db))->apiActorResolver();
        $this->inbox = $inbox ?: $container->inbox();
        $this->subscriptions = $subscriptions ?: $container->subscriptions();
    }
    public function supports(string $route): bool { return isset(self::ROUTES[$route]); }
    public function requiresContentSecurity(string $route): bool { return false; }
    public function dispatch(string $route): void
    {
        if (!$this->supports($route)) { $this->fail('接口不存在', 'NOT_FOUND', 404); return; }
        $header = trim((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? ''));
        if ($header === '' && function_exists('getallheaders')) {
            $headers = getallheaders();
            $header = trim((string)($headers['Authorization'] ?? $headers['authorization'] ?? ''));
        }
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{64})$/', $header, $matches) !== 1) { $this->fail('请重新登录','UNAUTHORIZED',401); return; }
        try { $actor = $this->actors->resolve($matches[1]); }
        catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
            $status = in_array($exception->getCode(), [401,403,503], true) ? (int)$exception->getCode() : 401;
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $status === 503 ? 'MINIAPP_APPID_MISSING' : 'UNAUTHORIZED', $status);
            return;
        }
        try {
            // The demo boundary precedes method/body validation, as in the old dispatch.
            if ($route === 'subscriptions.preference' && !empty($actor['is_demo_actor'])) {
                $this->subscriptions->save($actor, []);
            }
            if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== self::ROUTES[$route]) {
                $this->fail('请求方式不正确','METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',405); return;
            }
            $raw = self::ROUTES[$route] === 'POST' ? file_get_contents('php://input') : '';
            // Retain the legacy empty/malformed-body fallback for these existing endpoints.
            $body = json_decode(is_string($raw) ? $raw : '', true);
            $body = is_array($body) ? $body : [];
            if ($route === 'subscriptions.preference') { \json_response(['ok'=>true] + $this->subscriptions->save($actor, $body)); return; }
            if ($route === 'announcement.current') $data=$this->announcement->current((string)($_GET['scene']??''));
            elseif ($route === 'subscriptions.status') $data = $this->subscriptions->status($actor, (string)($_GET['include_application'] ?? '') === '1');
            elseif ($route === 'subscriptions.diagnose') $data = $this->subscriptions->diagnose($actor);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.summary') $data = $this->inbox->summary($actor);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.threads') $data=$this->inbox->threads($actor,$this->cursorInput($_GET['cursor']??''));
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.thread_messages') $data=$this->inbox->threadMessages($actor,(string)($_GET['cursor']??''));
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.list') $data = $this->inbox->list($actor, (int)($_GET['page'] ?? 1), (string)($_GET['through_id'] ?? ''));
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.read_batch') $data = $this->inbox->readBatch($actor, is_array($body['ids'] ?? null) ? $body['ids'] : []);
            elseif ($route === 'notifications.read') {
                $this->inbox->read($actor, (string)($body['id'] ?? ''));
                \json_response(['ok'=>true,'message'=>'已标记为已读']); return;
            } else {
                if(array_key_exists('range_cursor',$body))$this->inbox->readRange($actor,$this->cursorInput($body['range_cursor']));
                else $this->inbox->readAll($actor, (string)($body['through_id'] ?? ''));
                \json_response(['ok'=>true,'message'=>'未读消息已清除']); return;
            }
            $result = ['ok'=>true,'data'=>$data];
            if ($route === 'notifications.read_batch') $result['message'] = '消息已标记为已读';
            \json_response($result);
        } catch (MessageOperationException $exception) {
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $exception->apiCode(), (int)$exception->getCode());
        } catch (OrderOperationException $exception) {
            $this->fail($exception->getMessage(), $exception->apiCode(), (int)$exception->getCode());
        }
    }
    private function cursorInput($value): string
    {
        if(!is_string($value))throw new MessageOperationException('通知浏览范围无效','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);
        return $value;
    }
    private function fail(string $message, string $code, int $status): void
    { \json_response(['ok'=>false,'code'=>$code,'message'=>$message,'request_id'=>\request_id()], $status); }
}

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use PDO;
use PDOException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

class Database
{
    private $config;
    private $pdo;
    private $transactionDepth = 0;
    private $transactionRollbackOnly = false;
    private array $beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
    private bool $runningBeforeCommit = false;

    // 2026-08-14：统一 PDO 连接并强制真实预处理，兼容 MySQL 5.7.44。
    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
    }

    public function pdo()
    {
        if ($this->pdo instanceof PDO) {
            return $this->pdo;
        }
        if (!extension_loaded('pdo_mysql')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('服务器未安装 pdo_mysql 扩展。');
        }

        $host = isset($this->config['host']) ? $this->config['host'] : '127.0.0.1';
        $port = isset($this->config['port']) ? (int) $this->config['port'] : 3306;
        $database = isset($this->config['database']) ? $this->config['database'] : '';
        $charset = isset($this->config['charset']) ? $this->config['charset'] : 'utf8mb4';
        if ($database === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库名称尚未配置。');
        }

        $dsn = sprintf('mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=%s', $host, $port, $database, $charset);
        try {
            $this->pdo = new PDO($dsn, (string) $this->config['username'], (string) $this->config['password'], [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT => 5,
            ]);
            $this->pdo->exec("SET SESSION sql_mode='STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'");
            $this->pdo->exec("SET time_zone='+00:00'");
        } catch (PDOException $exception) {
            throw new RuntimeException('数据库连接失败，请检查安装配置。', 0, $exception);
        }

        return $this->pdo;
    }

    /**
     * MySQL 原生预处理不允许在同一条 SQL 中重复使用同名占位符。
     * 这里仅展开重复命名参数，继续保持 ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false，避免各业务控制器重复踩坑。
     */
    private function prepareAndExecute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        list($sql, $params) = $this->expandDuplicateNamedParameters((string) $sql, $params);
        $statement = $this->pdo()->prepare($sql);
        $statement->execute($params);
        return $statement;
    }

    private function expandDuplicateNamedParameters($sql, array $params)
    {
        if (!$params || strpos($sql, ':') === false) {
            return [$sql, $params];
        }

        $normalized = [];
        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
            $normalized[ltrim((string) $key, ':')] = $value;
        }
        $seen = [];
        $expanded = [];
        $rewritten = preg_replace_callback('/(?<!:):([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b/', function ($match) use (&$seen, &$expanded, $normalized) {
            $name = $match[1];
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $normalized)) {
                return $match[0];
            }
            $index = isset($seen[$name]) ? ++$seen[$name] : ($seen[$name] = 1);
            $target = $index === 1 ? $name : $name . '__dup' . $index;
            $expanded[$target] = $normalized[$name];
            return ':' . $target;
        }, $sql);

        // 保留未出现在 SQL 中的参数会触发 HY093；因此只传递实际匹配到的命名参数。
        // 本项目数据库层统一使用命名参数，若 SQL 没有匹配到占位符则沿用原参数以便显式暴露调用错误。
        return [$rewritten, $expanded ?: $params];
    }

    public function fetch($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $statement = $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params);
        $row = $statement->fetch();
        return $row === false ? null : $row;
    }

    public function fetchAll($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchAll();
    }

    public function fetchValue($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function execute($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        return $this->prepareAndExecute($sql, $params)->rowCount();
    }

    public function insert($sql, array $params = [])
    {
        $this->execute($sql, $params);
        return (int) $this->pdo()->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * 共享连接的事务加入语义：只有最外层真正 begin/commit；内层 transaction 加入当前事务。
     * 任一内层回调抛错都会把整笔用例标记 rollback-only，即使上层业务误捕获异常，也禁止提交部分结果。
     */
    public function transaction(callable $callback)
    {
        $pdo = $this->pdo();
        $outermost = $this->transactionDepth === 0;

        if ($outermost) {
            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
            $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        }
        $this->transactionDepth++;

        try {
            $result = $callback($this);

            if (!$outermost) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
                return $result;
            }

            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) {
                throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            }

            $this->runningBeforeCommit = true;
            ksort($this->beforeCommitCallbacks,SORT_STRING);
            foreach ($this->beforeCommitCallbacks as $beforeCommit) $beforeCommit($this);
            $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
            if ($this->transactionRollbackOnly) throw new RuntimeException('事务已因内部失败标记为回滚，禁止提交部分业务结果。');
            $this->transactionDepth--;
            $pdo->commit();
            $this->resetTransactionState();
            return $result;
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            if ($this->transactionDepth > 0) {
                $this->transactionDepth--;
            }
            $this->transactionRollbackOnly = true;

            if ($outermost) {
                if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
                    $pdo->rollBack();
                }
                $this->resetTransactionState();
            }
            throw $exception;
        }
    }

    /** Register bounded DML work after all outer/nested writes, before the same commit. */
    public function beforeCommit(string $key, callable $callback): void
    {
        if ($this->transactionDepth<1 || !$this->pdo()->inTransaction() || $this->runningBeforeCommit
            || $key==='' || strlen($key)>96 || (!isset($this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]) && count($this->beforeCommitCallbacks)>=128)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('预提交动作必须在原事务内登记且不得递归或超过上限');
        }
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks[$key]=$callback;
    }

    private function resetTransactionState()
    {
        $this->transactionDepth = 0;
        $this->transactionRollbackOnly = false;
        $this->beforeCommitCallbacks = [];
        $this->runningBeforeCommit = false;
    }

    public function tableExists($table)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table',
            ['table' => $table]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }

    public function columnExists($table, $column)
    {
        $count = $this->fetchValue(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = :table AND column_name = :column',
            ['table' => $table, 'column' => $column]
        );
        return (int) $count > 0;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Identity;

use RuntimeException;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\ApiActorRepository;
use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\SettingsProvider;

/**
 * 小程序 API 统一可信身份解析。
 *
 * 客户端只提供登录 token；user/worker/管理员与演示身份全部由服务端会话重新解析。
 */
final class ApiActorResolver
{
    private ApiActorRepository $repository;
    private SettingsProvider $settings;
    private bool $testingEnvironment;

    public function __construct(ApiActorRepository $repository, SettingsProvider $settings, bool $testingEnvironment = false)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->settings = $settings;
        $this->testingEnvironment = $testingEnvironment;
    }

    /** @return array<string,mixed> */
    public function resolve(string $token): array
    {
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$/', $token) !== 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录', 401);
        }
        return $this->resolveTokenHash(hash('sha256', $token));
    }

    /** Token repositories share actor resolution; their submit use case touches the session once. */
    public function resolveTokenHash(string $tokenHash, bool $touchSession = true): array
    {
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$/', $tokenHash) !== 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException('请重新登录', 401);
        }
        $appId = trim((string)$this->settings->get('wechat.miniapp_appid', ''));
        if ($appId === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('小程序登录配置不完整，请联系管理员', 503);
        }

        $actor = $this->repository->findByTokenHash($tokenHash, $appId);
        if (!$actor) {
            throw new RuntimeException('登录已过期，请重新进入小程序', 401);
        }
        if ($touchSession) $this->repository->touchSession((int)$actor['session_id']);

        $actor['worker_id'] = isset($actor['worker_id']) && $actor['worker_id'] !== null ? (int)$actor['worker_id'] : null;
        $actor['real_user_id'] = (int)$actor['user_id'];
        $actor['is_demo_actor'] = false;
        $actor['is_test_actor'] = false;
        $actor['demo_role'] = '';
        $actor['test_instance_id'] = isset($actor['test_instance_id']) && $actor['test_instance_id'] !== null ? (int)$actor['test_instance_id'] : null;

        $testUserId=(int)($actor['test_actor_user_id']??0);
        $testInstanceId=(int)($actor['test_instance_id']??0);
        $testExpires=(string)($actor['test_actor_expires_at']??'');
        $testExpiryTs=$testExpires!==''?strtotime($testExpires.' UTC'):false;
        $testActor=null;
        if($testUserId>0||$testInstanceId>0||$testExpires!==''){
            $validWindow=$testExpiryTs!==false&&$testExpiryTs>time();
            if($this->testingEnvironment&&$validWindow&&$this->isRealMiniAdmin($actor)&&$testUserId>0&&$testInstanceId>0){
                $testActor=$this->repository->findTestActor($testUserId,$testInstanceId);
            }
            if(!$testActor){
                $this->repository->clearTestActor((int)$actor['session_id']);
                $actor['test_actor_user_id']=null;$actor['test_instance_id']=null;$actor['test_actor_expires_at']=null;
            }else{
                $preserve=[
                    'session_id'=>$actor['session_id'],
                    'payer_openid'=>$actor['payer_openid']??'',
                    'real_user_id'=>$actor['real_user_id'],
                    'test_actor_user_id'=>$testUserId,
                    'test_instance_id'=>$testInstanceId,
                    'test_actor_expires_at'=>$testExpires,
                ];
                $actor=array_merge($actor,$testActor,$preserve);
                $actor['worker_id']=isset($actor['worker_id'])&&$actor['worker_id']!==null?(int)$actor['worker_id']:null;
                $actor['is_demo_actor']=true;
                $actor['is_test_actor']=true;
                $actor['demo_role']=(string)($testActor['test_role']??'');
            }
        }

        $demoUserId = (int)($actor['demo_actor_user_id'] ?? 0);
        if (!$testActor && $demoUserId > 0) {
            $canProxy = $this->isRealMiniAdmin($actor) && $this->settings->bool('demo.data_enabled', false);
            $demo = $canProxy ? $this->repository->findDemoActor($demoUserId) : null;
            if (!$demo) {
                $this->repository->clearDemoActor((int)$actor['session_id']);
                $actor['demo_actor_user_id'] = null;
            } else {
                $preserve = [
                    'session_id' => $actor['session_id'],
                    'payer_openid' => $actor['payer_openid'] ?? '',
                    'real_user_id' => $actor['real_user_id'],
                    'demo_actor_user_id' => $demoUserId,
                ];
                $actor = array_merge($actor, $demo, $preserve);
                $actor['worker_id'] = isset($actor['worker_id']) && $actor['worker_id'] !== null ? (int)$actor['worker_id'] : null;
                $actor['is_demo_actor'] = true;
                $actor['demo_role'] = (string)($demo['demo_role'] ?? '');
            }
        }

        // 订单模块统一使用服务端可信管理员标记；演示代理永远不继承真实管理员业务权限。
        $actor['is_admin'] = $this->isMiniAdmin($actor);
        $actor['business_admin'] = $actor['is_admin'];
        return $actor;
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $actor */
    public function isRealMiniAdmin(array $actor): bool
    {
        $openids = $this->settings->get('wechat.admin_openids', []);
        if (is_string($openids)) {
            $decoded = json_decode($openids, true);
            $openids = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : preg_split('/[\s,，]+/u', $openids, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        }
        if (!is_array($openids)) return false;
        $normalized = [];
        foreach ($openids as $openid) {
            $openid = trim((string)$openid);
            if ($openid !== '') $normalized[] = $openid;
        }
        return in_array(trim((string)($actor['payer_openid'] ?? '')), $normalized, true);
    }

    /** @param array<string,mixed> $actor */
    public function isMiniAdmin(array $actor): bool
    {
        return empty($actor['is_demo_actor']) && $this->isRealMiniAdmin($actor);
    }
}

                    $has('next_attempt_at') ? 'm.next_attempt_at' : 'NULL AS next_attempt_at',
                    $has('last_error') ? 'm.last_error' : 'NULL AS last_error',
                    $has('created_at') ? 'm.created_at' : 'NULL AS created_at',
                    $has('processed_at') ? 'm.processed_at' : ($has('updated_at') ? 'm.updated_at AS processed_at' : 'NULL AS processed_at'),
                ];
                $join = '';
                if ($paidSmsReady) {
                    $select[] = 'psi.delivery_status AS paid_delivery_status';
                    $select[] = 'psi.billing_status AS paid_billing_status';
                    $select[] = 'psi.worker_name_snapshot AS paid_worker_name';
                    $select[] = 'psi.fee_cents_snapshot AS paid_fee_cents';
                    $select[] = 'psb.public_no AS paid_batch_no';
                    $join = ' LEFT JOIN order_worker_sms_invites psi ON psi.outbox_id=m.id LEFT JOIN order_worker_sms_batches psb ON psb.id=psi.batch_id';
                } else {
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_delivery_status';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_billing_status';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_worker_name';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_fee_cents';
                    $select[] = 'NULL AS paid_batch_no';
                }
                $result = $this->paginate(
                    'SELECT ' . implode(',', $select) . ' FROM message_outbox m' . $join . ' WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where) . ' ORDER BY m.id DESC',
                    'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox m WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $where),
                    $params, $tab === 'records' ? $page : 1
                );

                foreach ($result['rows'] as &$messageRow) {
                    $safeError = (string) ($messageRow['last_error'] ?? '');
                    $safeError = preg_replace('/(?<!\\d)1[3-9]\\d{9}(?!\\d)/', '1**********', $safeError);
                    $safeError = preg_replace('#https?://qyapi\\.weixin\\.qq\\.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send\\?key=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+#i', '企业微信 Webhook 地址已隐藏', $safeError);
                    $messageRow['last_error_display'] = mb_substr((string) $safeError, 0, 1000);
                }
                unset($messageRow);

                if ($has('attempt_count')) {
                    $failedCount = (int) $this->db->fetchValue("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_outbox WHERE topic IN ('aliyun_sms','wecom_webhook','wechat_subscribe') AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5");
                }
            } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                \write_log('admin-message-outbox', '[' . date('c') . '] list read failed: ' . mb_substr($exception->getMessage(), 0, 500) . "\n");
                $result = ['rows'=>[], 'total'=>0, 'page'=>1, 'pages'=>1, 'per_page'=>20];
                $failedCount = 0;
                $schemaWarning = '消息发送记录读取失败。后台其他功能不受影响，请检查数据库升级状态或服务器日志后重试。';
            }
        }

        if($this->db->tableExists('sms_recipient_suppressions')){
            try{
                $suppressionResult=$this->paginate(
                    "SELECT id,mobile_masked,reason,note,status,created_at,updated_at FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE status='active' ORDER BY id DESC",
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE status='active'",
                    [], $tab === 'suppressions' ? $page : 1
                );
            }catch(Throwable $exception){
                \write_log('admin-sms-suppression','['.date('c').'] list failed: '.mb_substr($exception->getMessage(),0,500)."\n");
            }
        }

        return [
            'result'=>$result,
            'suppressionResult'=>$suppressionResult,
            'status'=>$status,
            'q'=>$q,
            'failedCount'=>$failedCount,
            'schemaWarning'=>$schemaWarning,
        ];

    }

    public function retry(int $id): array
    {
        $schema = $this->schema();
        $columns = (array) ($schema['columns'] ?? []);
        if (empty($schema['ready']) || !isset($columns['attempt_count'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException((string)(($schema['message'] ?? '') ?: '消息发送记录表缺少重试字段，请先完成数据库升级。'));
        }

        $message = $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($id, $columns) {
            $row = $db->fetch('SELECT id,topic,status,attempt_count FROM message_outbox WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id' => $id]);
            MessageOutboxPolicy::requireDeadLetter($row, 'retry');
            $sets = ["status='pending'", 'attempt_count=0'];
            if (isset($columns['next_attempt_at'])) $sets[] = 'next_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()';
            if (isset($columns['last_error'])) $sets[] = 'last_error=NULL';
            if (isset($columns['processed_at'])) $sets[] = 'processed_at=NULL';
            $changed = $db->execute('UPDATE message_outbox SET ' . implode(',', $sets) . " WHERE id=:id AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5", ['id' => $id]);
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('消息状态已变化，没有重复加入重试队列。');
            return $row;
        });
        return $message;
    }

    public function close(int $id): array
    {
        $schema = $this->schema();
        $columns = (array) ($schema['columns'] ?? []);
        if (empty($schema['ready']) || !isset($columns['attempt_count'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException((string)(($schema['message'] ?? '') ?: '消息发送记录表缺少结案所需字段，请先完成数据库升级。'));
        }

        $message = $this->db->transaction(function (Database $db) use ($id, $columns) {
            $row = $db->fetch('SELECT id,topic,status,attempt_count FROM message_outbox WHERE id=:id FOR UPDATE', ['id' => $id]);
            MessageOutboxPolicy::requireDeadLetter($row, 'close');
            $sets = ["status='closed'"];
            if (isset($columns['next_attempt_at'])) $sets[] = 'next_attempt_at=NULL';
            $changed = $db->execute('UPDATE message_outbox SET ' . implode(',', $sets) . " WHERE id=:id AND status='failed' AND attempt_count>=5", ['id' => $id]);
            if ($changed !== 1) throw new RuntimeException('消息状态已变化，没有执行结案。');
            return $row;
        });
        return $message;
    }

    public function addSuppression(string $hmac, string $masked, string $reason, string $note, int $adminId): void
    {
        if(!$this->db->tableExists('sms_recipient_suppressions')){
            throw new RuntimeException('短信抑制名单表尚未建立，请先完成数据库升级。');
        }
        $this->db->execute(
            "INSERT INTO sms_recipient_suppressions
             (mobile_hmac,mobile_masked,reason,note,status,created_by_admin_id,created_at,updated_at)
             VALUES(:hmac,:masked,:reason,:note,'active',:admin,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP())
             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mobile_masked=VALUES(mobile_masked),reason=VALUES(reason),note=VALUES(note),
                                     status='active',created_by_admin_id=VALUES(created_by_admin_id),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()",
            ['hmac'=>$hmac,'masked'=>$masked,'reason'=>$reason,'note'=>$note!==''?$note:null,'admin'=>$adminId]
        );
    }

    public function removeSuppression(int $id): array
    {
        $row=$this->db->fetch('SELECT id,mobile_masked,status FROM sms_recipient_suppressions WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1',['id'=>$id]);
        if(!$row)throw new RuntimeException('抑制名单记录不存在。');
        $this->db->execute(
            "UPDATE sms_recipient_suppressions SET status='inactive',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id=:id AND status='active'",
            ['id'=>$id]
        );
        return $row;
    }
    private function paginate($sql, $countSql, array $params, int $page)
    {
        $page=max(1,$page); $perPage=20; $total=(int)$this->db->fetchValue($countSql,$params); $pages=max(1,(int)ceil($total/$perPage)); $page=min($page,$pages); $offset=($page-1)*$perPage;
        $rows=$this->db->fetchAll($sql.' LIMIT '.$perPage.' OFFSET '.$offset,$params);
        return ['rows'=>$rows,'total'=>$total,'page'=>$page,'pages'=>$pages,'per_page'=>$perPage];
    }
}

{
    private MessageOutboxRepository $repository;

    public function __construct(MessageOutboxRepository $repository, MobileNumberProtection $mobile)
    { $this->repository = $repository; $this->mobile = $mobile; }

    public function dashboard(string $status, string $q, int $page, string $tab = 'records'): array
    {
        if (!in_array($status, ['pending','processing','failed','processed','closed'], true)) $status = '';
        if (!in_array($tab, ['records','suppressions'], true)) $tab = 'records';
        $data = $this->repository->dashboard($status, mb_substr(trim($q), 0, 100), max(1, $page), $tab);
        $catalog = MessageEventCatalog::all();
        $rows = is_array($data['result']['rows'] ?? null) ? $data['result']['rows'] : [];
        foreach ($rows as &$row) {
            $payload = json_decode((string)($row['_payload_json'] ?? ''), true);
            $payload = is_array($payload) ? $payload : [];
            $eventType = trim((string)($payload['event_type'] ?? ''));
            $sceneKey = trim((string)($payload['scene_key'] ?? ''));
            $title = trim((string)($payload['title'] ?? ''));
            $row['business_label'] = $this->businessLabel((string)($row['topic'] ?? ''), $eventType, $sceneKey, $title, $catalog);
            $row['business_context'] = $this->businessContext($payload);
            unset($row['_payload_json']);
        }
        unset($row);
        if (!isset($data['result']) || !is_array($data['result'])) $data['result'] = [];
        $data['result']['rows'] = $rows;
        $data['activeTab'] = $tab;
        return $data;
    }

    public function retry(int $id): array { $this->requireId($id); return $this->repository->retry($id); }
    public function close(int $id, string $reason): array
    {
        $this->requireId($id);
        $reason = trim($reason);
        if (mb_strlen($reason, 'UTF-8') < 5 || mb_strlen($reason, 'UTF-8') > 200) throw new RuntimeException('结案原因请填写 5～200 个字。');
        return $this->repository->close($id);
    }
    public function addSuppression(string $value, string $reason, string $note, int $adminId): array
    {
        $mobile = $this->mobile->normalize($value);
        if ($mobile === '') throw new RuntimeException('请输入有效的 11 位手机号。');
        if (!in_array($reason, ['opt_out','complaint','manual'], true)) $reason = 'manual';
        $note = trim($note);
        if (mb_strlen($note, 'UTF-8') > 300) throw new RuntimeException('备注最多 300 个字。');
        $masked = substr($mobile, 0, 3).'****'.substr($mobile, -4);
        $this->repository->addSuppression($this->mobile->hmac($mobile), $masked, $reason, $note, $adminId);
        return ['masked' => $masked, 'reason' => $reason];
    }
    public function removeSuppression(int $id): array { $this->requireId($id); return $this->repository->removeSuppression($id); }

    private function businessLabel(string $topic, string $eventType, string $sceneKey, string $title, array $catalog): string
    {
        $specialEvents = [
            'worker_profile_submitted'=>'师傅入驻 / 资料审核',
            'worker_realname_submitted'=>'师傅实名认证审核',

            'platform_change_requested'=>'平台承接单费用调整',
        ];
        if ($eventType !== '' && isset($specialEvents[$eventType])) return $specialEvents[$eventType];
        if ($title !== '') return mb_substr($title, 0, 60, 'UTF-8');
        if ($eventType !== '' && isset($catalog[$eventType])) return (string)($catalog[$eventType]['label'] ?? $eventType);
        $sceneLabels = [
            'reviewResult'=>'师傅入驻审核结果',
            'user_order_update'=>'用户订单进度通知',
            'worker_order_update'=>'师傅订单进度通知',
            'payment_success'=>'支付结果通知',
            'payment_pending'=>'待支付提醒',
            'refund_result'=>'退款结果通知',
            'quote_received'=>'收到报价提醒',
            'worker_assigned'=>'师傅安排通知',
            'completion_submitted'=>'完工待验收通知',
            'measurement_result'=>'测量成果通知',
            'repair_progress'=>'售后维修进度',
        ];
        if ($sceneKey !== '' && isset($sceneLabels[$sceneKey])) return $sceneLabels[$sceneKey];
        if ($topic === 'aliyun_paid_sms') return '附近师傅短信邀请';
        if ($topic === 'wechat.refund.request') return '微信退款请求';
        $topicLabels = ['aliyun_sms'=>'业务短信通知','wecom_webhook'=>'企业微信管理员通知','wechat_subscribe'=>'微信订阅消息'];

        $orderNo = trim((string)($parameters['order_no'] ?? $payload['order_no'] ?? ''));
        if ($orderNo !== '') $parts[] = '订单 '.$orderNo;
        $workerName = trim((string)($payload['worker_name'] ?? ''));
        if ($workerName !== '') $parts[] = '师傅 '.mb_substr($workerName, 0, 30, 'UTF-8');
        return implode(' · ', $parts);
    }

    private function requireId(int $id): void { if ($id < 1) throw new RuntimeException('缺少有效记录编号。'); }

namespace WorkerAdmin\Application\Identity;

use WorkerAdmin\Contracts\PrivateValueCipher;
use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Identity\MobileNumber;

/**
 * 手机号规范化与隐私保护应用服务。
 */
final class MobileNumberProtection
{
    private const SMS_CONTEXT = 'sms-recipient-mobile';

    private PrivateValueCipher $cipher;

    public function __construct(PrivateValueCipher $cipher)
    {
        $this->cipher = $cipher;
    }

    public function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        return MobileNumber::normalize($value);
    }

    public function hmac(string $canonical): string
    {
        return $canonical === '' ? '' : $this->cipher->hmac($canonical, self::SMS_CONTEXT);
    }

    public function encrypt(string $canonical): ?string
    {
        return $canonical === '' ? null : $this->cipher->encrypt($canonical, self::SMS_CONTEXT);
    }

    public function decrypt(?string $cipherText): string
    {
        if (!$cipherText) {
            return '';
        }
        return MobileNumber::normalize($this->cipher->decrypt($cipherText, self::SMS_CONTEXT));
    }

    public function workerProfileMobile(array $worker): string
    {
        $cipherText = (string) ($worker['mobile_ciphertext'] ?? '');
        if ($cipherText === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $raw = $this->cipher->decrypt($cipherText, 'worker-mobile');
        if ($raw === '') {
            $raw = $this->cipher->decrypt($cipherText, 'user-mobile');
        }
        if ($raw === '') {
            $raw = $cipherText;
        }

        return MobileNumber::normalize($raw);
    }
}

    /** Eligibility is checked against the row locked by the persistence operation. */
    public static function requireDeadLetter(?array $row, string $operation): void
    {
        if ($row && $row['topic'] === 'aliyun_paid_sms' && $operation === 'retry') {
            throw new RuntimeException('付费短信禁止从普通消息重试入口重新发送；仅允许用户在明确失败且费用已释放后重新发起。');

            throw new RuntimeException($operation === 'retry' ? '仅可人工重试已达到 5 次自动重试上限的失败消息；请刷新页面确认当前状态。' : '仅可结案已达到 5 次自动重试上限的失败消息；请刷新页面确认当前状态。');
        }
    }

            if ($route === 'message-outbox') {

            if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== 'POST') throw $exception;

    private function returnTab(string $route): string

<?php

namespace WorkerAdmin\Core;

use RuntimeException;

class Auth
{
    private $db;
    private $userLoaded = false;
    private $user;

    private $permissions = [
        'operations' => ['chat.images.review', 'dashboard.view', 'orders.manage', 'workers.manage', 'users.view', 'users.manage', 'catalog.manage', 'help.manage', 'reviews.manage', 'disputes.manage', 'audit.view'],
        'finance' => ['dashboard.view', 'orders.view', 'payments.manage', 'refunds.manage', 'commissions.manage', 'withdrawals.manage', 'audit.view'],
        'viewer' => ['dashboard.view', 'orders.view', 'users.view'],
    ];

    public function __construct(Database $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    // 2026-08-14：登录包含失败锁定、会话轮换和密码哈希升级。
    public function attempt($username, $password)
    {
        $username = trim((string) $username);
        $user = $this->db->fetch('SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE username = :username LIMIT 1', ['username' => $username]);
        if (!$user || !in_array((string) $user['status'], ['active', '1'], true)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!empty($user['locked_until']) && strtotime($user['locked_until'] . ' UTC') > time()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('登录失败次数过多，请稍后再试。');
        }

        if (!password_verify((string) $password, $user['password_hash'])) {
            $attempts = (int) $user['failed_attempts'] + 1;
            $max = (int) \app_config('security.login_max_attempts', 5);
            // 2026-08-14：锁定时间按 UTC 写库，与订单及审计时间约定保持一致。
            $lockedUntil = $attempts >= $max ? gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + ((int) \app_config('security.login_lock_minutes', 15) * 60)) : null;
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=:attempts, locked_until=:locked_until, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=:id', [
                'attempts' => $attempts, 'locked_until' => $lockedUntil, 'id' => $user['id'],
            ]);
            return false;
        }

        if (password_needs_rehash($user['password_hash'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12])) {
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET password_hash=:hash WHERE id=:id', [
                'hash' => password_hash((string) $password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]), 'id' => $user['id'],
            ]);
        }

        $this->revokeChatIdentity();
        session_regenerate_id(true);
        $_SESSION['admin_id'] = (int) $user['id'];
        $_SESSION['admin_login_at'] = time();
        $this->db->execute('UPDATE admin_users SET failed_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL, last_login_at=NOW(), last_login_ip=:ip, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=:id', [
            'ip' => \request_ip(), 'id' => $user['id'],
        ]);
        $this->userLoaded = false;
        $this->user = null;
        \csrf()->rotate();
        return true;
    }

    public function user()
    {
        if ($this->userLoaded) {
            return $this->user;
        }
        $this->userLoaded = true;
        if (empty($_SESSION['admin_id'])) {
            return $this->user = null;
        }
        // 2026-08-14：管理员表不保存手机号，避免查询不存在字段导致登录后页面报错。
        $this->user = $this->db->fetch('SELECT id, username, real_name, role, status, must_change_password, last_login_at, last_login_ip, created_at FROM admin_users WHERE id=:id LIMIT 1', ['id' => (int) $_SESSION['admin_id']]);
        if (!$this->user || !in_array((string) $this->user['status'], ['active', '1'], true)) {
            $this->logout();
            return null;
        }
        return $this->user;
    }

    public function check()
    {
        return $this->user() !== null;
    }

    public function logout()
    {
        $this->revokeChatIdentity();
        $this->user = null;
        $this->userLoaded = true;
        unset($_SESSION['admin_id'], $_SESSION['admin_login_at']);
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            session_regenerate_id(true);
        }
    }

    private function revokeChatIdentity(): void
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id'])) return;
        try {
            $this->db->execute('UPDATE chat_admin_sessions SET revoked_at=COALESCE(revoked_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) WHERE id=:id AND admin_id=:admin_id',
                ['id'=>(string)$_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id'],'admin_id'=>(string)($_SESSION['admin_id'] ?? '0')]);
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            // Don't report successful logout if persistent chat revocation failed.
            throw new RuntimeException('聊天会话暂时无法撤销，请稍后再试。');
        }
        unset($_SESSION['chat_admin_session_id']);
    }

    public function can($permission)
    {
        $user = $this->user();
        if (!$user) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($user['role'] === 'super_admin') {
            return true;
        }
        $grants = isset($this->permissions[$user['role']]) ? $this->permissions[$user['role']] : [];
        if (in_array($permission, $grants, true)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (substr($permission, -5) === '.view') {
            return in_array(str_replace('.view', '.manage', $permission), $grants, true);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public function requireLogin()
    {
        if (!$this->check()) {
            \redirect(\admin_url('login'));
        }
    }

    public function requirePermission($permission)
    {
        $this->requireLogin();
        if (!$this->can($permission)) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo \view('errors/403', ['pageTitle' => '无权访问']);
            exit;
        }
    }
}

                        SELECT 1 FROM after_sales astodo WHERE astodo.order_id=o.id AND astodo.type='warranty_repair'
                        AND (astodo.status='open' OR (astodo.status='processing' AND (astodo.resolution IS NULL OR (astodo.resolution NOT LIKE '师傅拒绝维修%' AND astodo.resolution NOT LIKE '用户申请平台介入%'))))
                    ))
                )";
                $params['todo_worker'] = $workerId;
                $params['todo_construction_worker'] = $workerId;
                $params['todo_invite_worker'] = $workerId;
                $params['todo_quote_worker'] = $workerId;
                $params['todo_repair_worker'] = $workerId;
            }
        } elseif ($status === 'supplement') {
            $where .= $kind === 'mine'
                ? " AND o.audit_status='supplement_required' AND o.lifecycle_status='active'"
                : ' AND 1=0';
        } elseif ($status === 'quoting') {
            $where .= $kind === 'mine'
                ? " AND o.audit_status='approved' AND o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.selected_quote_id IS NULL AND o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding')"
                : " AND o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.assignment_status<>'accepted' AND o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding')";
        } elseif ($status === 'progress') {
            if ($kind === 'mine') {
                $where .= " AND o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding') AND ((o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.selected_quote_id IS NOT NULL AND o.fulfillment_status<>'accepted') OR {$activeRepairSql})";
            } else {
                $where .= " AND o.assigned_worker_id=:progress_worker AND o.refund_status NOT IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding') AND ((o.assignment_status='accepted' AND o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.fulfillment_status<>'accepted') OR {$activeRepairSql})";
                $params['progress_worker'] = $workerId;
            }
        } elseif ($status === 'completed') {
            if ($kind === 'mine') {
                $where .= " AND (o.fulfillment_status='accepted' OR o.lifecycle_status='completed') AND NOT {$activeRepairSql}";
            } else {
                $where .= " AND o.assigned_worker_id=:completed_worker AND (o.fulfillment_status='accepted' OR o.lifecycle_status='completed') AND NOT {$activeRepairSql}";
                $params['completed_worker'] = $workerId;
            }
        } elseif ($status === 'refunding') {
            $where .= " AND (o.refund_status IN ('pending_review','approved','processing','refunding') OR o.lifecycle_status='cancel_approved_pending_refund')";
        }

        return [$where,$params];
    }

    public function page(array $actor, string $kind, string $status, int $page, int $limit, string $keyword = ''): array
    {
        $page = max(1, $page);
        $limit = max(1, min(50, $limit));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $limit;
        $workerId = (int)($actor['worker_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($kind !== 'mine' && $workerId < 1) return ['rows'=>[], 'has_more'=>false];
        [$where,$params] = self::scope($actor,$kind,$status,$keyword);
        $params['invite_worker_flag'] = $workerId;
        $params['invite_worker_lookup'] = $workerId;
        $params['invite_token_worker_lookup'] = $workerId;
        $params['invite_quote_worker_lookup'] = $workerId;
        $sql = "SELECT o.*,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quotes q WHERE q.order_id=o.id AND q.status IN ('active','selected')) quote_count,
                    (SELECT q.amount_cents FROM quotes q WHERE q.order_id=o.id AND q.worker_id=:own_worker_id ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1) own_quote_cents,
                    (SELECT mf.public_id FROM media_links ml JOIN media_files mf ON mf.id=ml.media_file_id AND mf.status='active'
                     WHERE ml.entity_type='order' AND ml.entity_id=o.id
                     ORDER BY FIELD(ml.purpose,'product','wall','completion','before_optional'),ml.sort_order,ml.id LIMIT 1) cover_media_id,
                    (SELECT c.public_id FROM change_requests c WHERE c.order_id=o.id AND c.status='pending' ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1) pending_change_id,
                    (SELECT rc.status FROM run_empty_fee_claims rc WHERE rc.order_id=o.id AND rc.status IN ('pending_confirmation','awaiting_payment') ORDER BY rc.id DESC LIMIT 1) pending_run_empty_status,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM after_sales ast WHERE ast.order_id=o.id AND ast.type='warranty_repair' AND (ast.status='open' OR (ast.status='processing' AND (ast.resolution IS NULL OR (ast.resolution NOT LIKE '师傅拒绝维修%' AND ast.resolution NOT LIKE '用户申请平台介入%'))))) pending_repair_count,
                    (SELECT ast2.status FROM after_sales ast2 WHERE ast2.order_id=o.id AND ast2.type='warranty_repair' AND ast2.status IN ('open','processing') ORDER BY ast2.id DESC LIMIT 1) active_repair_status,
                    CASE WHEN o.order_source_type='platform'
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events pr WHERE pr.order_id=o.id AND pr.event_type='platform_measurement_pricing_reviewed')
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END platform_pricing_reviewed,
                    CASE WHEN o.order_source_type='platform'
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events pr2 WHERE pr2.order_id=o.id AND pr2.event_type='platform_measurement_pricing_reviewed')
                        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events pc2 WHERE pc2.order_id=o.id AND pc2.event_type='platform_measurement_pricing_confirmed')
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END platform_pricing_confirmation_pending,
                    CASE WHEN o.order_source_type='platform'
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events pc3 WHERE pc3.order_id=o.id AND pc3.event_type='platform_measurement_pricing_confirmed')
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END platform_pricing_confirmed,
                    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointment_records pas WHERE pas.order_id=o.id AND pas.context_type='service')
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END service_appointment_exists,
                    CASE WHEN :invite_worker_flag>0 AND (
                        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments ai WHERE ai.order_id=o.id AND ai.worker_id=:invite_worker_lookup AND ai.assignment_type='invite')
                        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invite_tokens iti WHERE iti.order_id=o.id AND iti.claimed_worker_id=:invite_token_worker_lookup AND iti.status='claimed')
                    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_invited,
                    CASE WHEN o.order_source_type='platform' AND o.dispatch_mode='multi_quote' AND o.selected_quote_id IS NULL
                        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invite_tokens itr WHERE itr.order_id=o.id AND itr.claimed_worker_id=:invite_token_worker_lookup2 AND itr.status='claimed')
                        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quotes qir WHERE qir.order_id=o.id AND qir.worker_id=:invite_quote_worker_lookup AND qir.status IN ('active','selected'))
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END invite_requires_quote
                FROM orders o WHERE {$where}
                ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC,o.id DESC
                LIMIT " . ($limit + 1) . ' OFFSET ' . $offset;
        $params['invite_token_worker_lookup2'] = $workerId;
        $rows = $this->db->fetchAll($sql, $params);
        $hasMore = count($rows) > $limit;
        if ($hasMore) $rows = array_slice($rows, 0, $limit);
        return ['rows' => $rows, 'has_more' => $hasMore];
    }

    public function supplementCount(array $actor, string $kind): int

        }

                    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_events pcc WHERE pcc.order_id=o.id AND pcc.event_type='platform_measurement_pricing_confirmed')
                    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointment_records pac WHERE pac.order_id=o.id AND pac.context_type='service'))
                 OR (o.lifecycle_status='active' AND o.order_source_type='platform' AND o.dispatch_mode='multi_quote'
                    AND o.selected_quote_id IS NULL

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Core\Database;

final class SubscriptionQuotaStore
{

    public static function subscriptionPreferences(Database $db, int $userId): array
    {
        if ($userId < 1) return [];
        $raw = (string) ($db->fetchValue('SELECT setting_value FROM system_settings WHERE setting_key=:key LIMIT 1', ['key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]) ?: '');
        $decoded = $raw === '' ? [] : json_decode($raw, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) return [];
        // 无需新增表字段：旧 enabled/consumed 偏好在读取时补成计数模型，下次授权或消费即写回新结构。
        $scenes = SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        foreach ($decoded as $sceneKey => &$pref) {
            if (!is_array($pref)) { $pref = []; continue; }
            $scene = $scenes[$sceneKey] ?? [];
            $type = trim((string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? $scene['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time'));
            if (!in_array($type, ['one_time','long_term'], true)) $type = 'one_time';
            $status = (string)($pref['authorization_status'] ?? '');
            $legacyAccepted = !empty($pref['enabled']) && in_array($status, ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'], true);
            if ($type === 'one_time') {
                $remaining = array_key_exists('remaining_count', $pref) ? max(0, (int)$pref['remaining_count']) : ($legacyAccepted ? 1 : 0);
                $pref['remaining_count'] = $remaining;
                if (!array_key_exists('total_authorized_count', $pref)) $pref['total_authorized_count'] = $remaining;
                // 一次性订阅的“拒绝”只代表本次没有新增额度，不应抹掉之前已经积累的可发送次数。
                // 旧数据若出现 remaining_count>0 但状态为 reject/consumed，读取时恢复为可用。
                if ($remaining > 0 && in_array($status, ['consumed','reject'], true)) $pref['authorization_status'] = 'accept';
                if (!array_key_exists('last_request_status', $pref) && $status !== '') $pref['last_request_status'] = $status;
            } else {
                $pref['remaining_count'] = null;
                if (!array_key_exists('total_authorized_count', $pref)) $pref['total_authorized_count'] = $legacyAccepted ? 1 : 0;
            }
            $pref['subscription_type'] = $type;
        }
        unset($pref);
        return $decoded;
    }

    public static function saveSubscriptionPreference(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey, bool $enabled, string $authorizationStatus): array
    {
        $scenes = SubscriptionCatalog::subscriptionSceneDefinitions();
        if ($userId < 1 || !isset($scenes[$sceneKey])) throw new \RuntimeException('订阅场景不存在。');
        if ($enabled && empty($scenes[$sceneKey]['available'])) throw new \RuntimeException('该订阅场景尚未在后台配置可用模板。');
        $allowed = ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert','reject','ban','filter','disabled','consumed','error',''];
        if (!in_array($authorizationStatus, $allowed, true)) $authorizationStatus = $enabled ? 'accept' : 'disabled';
        if ($enabled && $authorizationStatus === '') $authorizationStatus = 'accept';
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        $previous = is_array($preferences[$sceneKey] ?? null) ? $preferences[$sceneKey] : [];
        $type = (string)($scenes[$sceneKey]['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time');
        $accepted = in_array($authorizationStatus, ['accept','acceptWithAudio','acceptWithAlert'], true);
        $remaining = $type === 'one_time' ? max(0, (int)($previous['remaining_count'] ?? 0)) : null;
        $total = max(0, (int)($previous['total_authorized_count'] ?? 0));
        $effectiveStatus = $authorizationStatus;
        if ($accepted) {
            $enabled = true;
            if ($type === 'one_time') $remaining++;
            $total++;
        } elseif ($type === 'one_time' && in_array($authorizationStatus, ['reject','filter'], true)) {
            // reject 只是本次没有新增额度；filter 是微信因同标题过滤，本质也不是授权失效。
            // 两种情况都保留之前已经积累的 remaining_count。
            $enabled = $remaining > 0;
            $effectiveStatus = $remaining > 0 ? 'accept' : $authorizationStatus;
        } elseif (in_array($authorizationStatus, ['ban','disabled'], true)) {
            $enabled = false;
        } elseif ($type === 'one_time' && $remaining > 0) {
            $enabled = true;
            $effectiveStatus = 'accept';
        }
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = array_merge($previous, [
            'enabled'=>(bool)$enabled,
            'authorization_status'=>$effectiveStatus,
            'last_request_status'=>$authorizationStatus,
            'subscription_type'=>$type,
            'remaining_count'=>$remaining,
            'total_authorized_count'=>$total,
            'template_id'=>(string)$scenes[$sceneKey]['template_id'],
            'updated_at'=>gmdate('c'),
        ]);
        if ($accepted) $preferences[$sceneKey]['last_authorized_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute("INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,value_type,group_name,is_public,description,updated_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(:key,:value,'json','notification_user',0,'用户微信订阅消息偏好',NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value=VALUES(setting_value),value_type='json',group_name='notification_user',is_public=0,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP()", ['key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId),'value'=>$json]);
        return $preferences[$sceneKey];
    }

    public static function markSubscriptionConsumed(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey): void
    {
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        if (!isset($preferences[$sceneKey]) || !is_array($preferences[$sceneKey])) return;
        $pref = $preferences[$sceneKey];
        $type = (string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time');
        if ($type === 'one_time') {
            $remaining = max(0, (int)($pref['remaining_count'] ?? 0) - 1);
            $pref['remaining_count'] = $remaining;
            $pref['authorization_status'] = $remaining > 0 ? 'accept' : 'consumed';
        } else {
            $pref['authorization_status'] = 'accept';
        }
        $pref['last_consumed_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $pref['updated_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = $pref;
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute('UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value=:value,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE setting_key=:key', ['value'=>$json,'key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]);
    }

    public static function markSubscriptionPermissionUnavailable(Database $db, int $userId, string $sceneKey): void
    {
        $preferences = self::subscriptionPreferences($db, $userId);
        if (!isset($preferences[$sceneKey]) || !is_array($preferences[$sceneKey])) return;
        $pref = $preferences[$sceneKey];
        if ((string)($pref['subscription_type'] ?? 'one_time') === 'one_time') $pref['remaining_count'] = 0;
        $pref['authorization_status'] = 'consumed';
        $pref['updated_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $preferences[$sceneKey] = $pref;
        $json = json_encode($preferences, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        $db->execute('UPDATE system_settings SET setting_value=:value,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE setting_key=:key', ['value'=>$json,'key'=>self::subscriptionPreferenceKey($userId)]);
    }

    private static function subscriptionPreferenceKey(int $userId): string
    {
        return 'wechat.subscription.user.'.$userId;
    }
}

    public static function get(string $eventType): ?array
    {
        $all = self::all();
        return $all[$eventType] ?? null;
    }

    public static function switches(string $channel, array $configured): array
    {
        $all = self::all();
        $visibleKey = $channel === 'wecom' ? 'wecom_visible' : ($channel === 'inapp' ? 'inapp_visible' : 'sms_visible');
        $result = [];

        foreach ($all as $eventKey => $meta) {
            if (empty($meta[$visibleKey])) continue;
            $saved = $configured[$eventKey] ?? null;
            $enabled = $saved === null ? $channel === 'inapp' : filter_var(is_array($saved) ? ($saved['enabled'] ?? false) : $saved, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
            $extra = is_array($saved) ? $saved : [];
            $extra['enabled'] = $enabled;
            $extra['priority'] = (string) ($channel==='sms'?($meta['sms_priority']??'normal'):$meta['priority']);
            $result[$eventKey] = $extra;
        }
        foreach ($configured as $eventKey => $saved) {
            if (isset($result[$eventKey]) || isset($all[$eventKey])) continue;
            $extra = is_array($saved) ? $saved : [];
            $extra['enabled'] = filter_var(is_array($saved) ? ($saved['enabled'] ?? false) : $saved, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
            $extra['priority'] = isset($extra['priority']) && $extra['priority'] === 'normal' ? 'normal' : 'important';
            $result[(string)$eventKey] = $extra;
        }

        return $result;
    }

    public static function enabled(string $channel, string $eventType, array $configured): bool
    {
        $switches = self::switches($channel, $configured);
        return isset($switches[$eventType]) && !empty($switches[$eventType]['enabled']);
    }

final class MobileNumber
{
    public static function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        $value = trim($value);
        if ($value === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $value);
        if (!is_string($digits)) {
            return '';
        }
        if (strpos($digits, '0086') === 0) {
            $digits = substr($digits, 4);
        } elseif (strpos($digits, '86') === 0 && strlen($digits) === 13) {
            $digits = substr($digits, 2);
        }

        return preg_match('/^1\d{10}$/', $digits) === 1 ? $digits : '';
    }

    {

}

final class AdminRequestGuard
{
    private Auth $auth;
    private Csrf $csrf;

    public function __construct(Auth $auth, Csrf $csrf)
    {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->csrf = $csrf;
    }

    public function inspect(string $route): void
    {
        if ($route === 'chat.credentials') {
            $status = 0;
            if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) !== 'POST') {
                header('Allow: POST'); $status = 405;
            } elseif (!$this->auth->check()) { $status = 401;
            } elseif (!empty($this->auth->user()['must_change_password'])) { $status = 403;
            } else {
                try { $this->csrf->verifyRequest(); } catch (\RuntimeException $error) { $status = 403; }
            }
            if ($status) \json_response(['ok'=>false,'code'=>$status===401?'CHAT_UNAUTHORIZED':($status===405?'CHAT_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED':'CHAT_FORBIDDEN'),
                'message'=>'请刷新页面后重试','retryable'=>false,'request_id'=>\request_id(),'server_time'=>gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z')],$status);
            return;
        }
        if ($route === 'login') return;
        $this->auth->requireLogin();
        $user = $this->auth->user();
        if (!empty($user['must_change_password']) && !in_array($route, ['profile','profile.password','logout'], true)) {
            \flash('warning', '首次登录必须先修改演示密码。');
            \redirect(\admin_url('profile'));
        }
        if (strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')) === 'POST') {
            $this->csrf->verifyRequest();
        }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace WorkerAdmin\Infrastructure\Messaging;

use WorkerAdmin\Domain\Messaging\MessageOperationException;

/** Ten-minute, actor/environment-bound pagination; the cursor never grants ownership. */
final class NotificationInboxCursor
{
    private function key(): string
    {
        $key=(string)\app_config('app.key','');
        if(strlen($key)<32)throw new MessageOperationException('通知分页暂不可用，请稍后重试','NOTIFICATION_CURSOR_UNAVAILABLE',503);
        return hash_hmac('sha256','notification-inbox:v1:'.(string)\app_config('app.env','production'),$key,true);
    }
    private function scope(array $actor): string
    {
        $values=[];
        foreach(['user_id','worker_id','is_demo_actor','test_instance_id','demo_actor_id','login_user_id'] as $name)$values[$name]=(string)($actor[$name]??'');
        return hash('sha256',json_encode($values,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }
    public function begin(array $actor,string $max,string $count): array
    {
        return ['v'=>1,'scope'=>$this->scope($actor),'max'=>$max,'count'=>$count,'exp'=>time()+600,'kind'=>'range','thread'=>'','before'=>''];
    }
    public function seal(array $state,string $kind,string $thread='',string $before=''): string
    {
        $state['kind']=$kind;$state['thread']=$thread;$state['before']=$before;
        $raw=json_encode($state,JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $encoded=rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($raw),'+/','-_'),'=');
        return $encoded.'.'.hash_hmac('sha256',$encoded,$this->key());
    }
    public function open(array $actor,string $cursor,string $kind): array
    {
        $this->key();
        if(strlen($cursor)>2048||preg_match('/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\.([a-f0-9]{64})$/D',$cursor,$m)!==1
            ||!hash_equals(hash_hmac('sha256',$m[1],$this->key()),$m[2]))$this->invalid();
        $raw=base64_decode(strtr($m[1],'-_','+/'),true);
        $p=is_string($raw)?json_decode($raw,true):null;
        $fields=['v','scope','max','count','exp','kind','thread','before'];
        if(!is_array($p)||array_keys($p)!==$fields||$p['v']!==1||$p['scope']!==$this->scope($actor)||$p['kind']!==$kind
            ||!is_int($p['exp'])||$p['exp']<=time()||$p['exp']>time()+600
            ||!is_string($p['max'])||!is_string($p['count'])||!is_string($p['thread'])||!is_string($p['before'])
            ||preg_match('/^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$/D',$p['max'])!==1
            ||preg_match('/^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$/D',$p['count'])!==1
            ||($p['thread']!==''&&preg_match('/^(?:(?:user|worker):[1-9][0-9]{0,19}|single:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80})$/D',$p['thread'])!==1)
            ||($p['before']!==''&&preg_match('/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[0-9]{20}$/D',$p['before'])!==1))$this->invalid();
        if(($kind==='messages'&&$p['thread']==='')||($kind!=='messages'&&$p['thread']!==''))$this->invalid();
        return $p;
    }
    private function invalid(): void
    {throw new MessageOperationException('通知浏览范围已失效，请下拉刷新','NOTIFICATION_RESYNC_REQUIRED',409);}
}
